bear_case: Counter-argument: framework-rule BEARISH triggers fired at the bottom of a selloff are historically poor timing signals — the 7,460 floor was only 12 pts of buffer at Tuesday's open, consumed by a semiconductor-specific rout (KOSPI 'Black Tuesday,' GOOGL AI talent repricing) rather than a broad macro deterioration. The 10Y yield at 4.48% actually fell — bonds bid — and WTI at a 3-month low is unambiguously disinflation, not the stagflationary regime that justifies a full BEARISH downgrade. The Dow's near-flat close (-0.09%) and Russell 2000's -0.96% vs. Nasdaq -2.21% confirm that value and defensives are absorbing capital, not abandoning the market. The BEARISH conversion occurs 24 hours before the June 24 dual catalyst that has been the designated clearing event for weeks. Invalidation: if NVDA Annual Meeting delivers explicit AI demand confirmation AND Micron Q3 guides Q4 revenue above $36B → BEARISH was wrong; regime upgrades to HOLD on June 25 morning. If SPX reclaims 7,460 by June 24 close, the BEARISH conversion was a one-session false break.
